tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and the sheet. Plain white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Decision cards and menus, lifted off the page with shadow-lift.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Oat. The desk behind the sheet, the sidebar area and the insight panel.

tokens.name: paper-well
tokens.usage: Drafts and quoted messages inside the sheet. Lighter than oat so the yellow highlighter stands out on it.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only thing separating controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk. A warm near-black, so the page is not tinted by the brand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text on any paper surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Forest green. The one brand color: the primary button, the selected count, the wordmark tick, filled squares in Your work, finished-task ticks and the latest bar in a chart. Never for errors.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and the Today count. Deeper than brand in dark mode so forest green stays visible; label in on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Pale green ground: Done chips and the half-filled "you approve" squares.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter for a fact Ida pulled from a source. Tapping it opens the source. Only on cited facts.

tokens.name: margin-rule
tokens.usage: The notebook margin line, a pale tint of brand. Decorative.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Finished work. Same green as brand: in Ida, green means done. Always with a word or a tick.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the Done chip.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: A deadline at risk (for example a missing document before closing). As text on paper surfaces or attention-soft. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the Needs you chip.

tokens.name: problem
tokens.usage: Something broke or was blocked. A dark wine red, clearly darker than brand, so errors never read as branding. As text on paper surfaces or problem-soft. Always paired with a word (Problem, Blocked).

tokens.name: problem-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the Problem chip.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and secondary actions. An alias of ink; links are underlined, not colored.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Schibsted Grotesk from Google Fonts: a sturdy European newspaper grotesk. Everything the owner reads to make a decision is set in it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The daily greeting and marketing headlines. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles on the home screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Send the inspection summary to the Parks?

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ida drafted the email from the inspector's report. Nothing is sent until you approve.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, sources and timestamps, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chip text. Set in uppercase.

groups.name: Hand
groups.note: Kalam from Google Fonts. Accent only: margin notes, the wordmark, small reassurances. Never for decisions, numbers or anything the owner must act on.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: saved you about 3 hours this week
styles.usage: Margin notes and annotations, in brand.

styles.name: note-lg
styles.usage: The wordmark and a calm empty state. Once per screen at most.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous gaps: the page should feel like an uncluttered desk.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page, desktop gutter.

radius.note: Soft corners, like the edge of an index card. Pills only for chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips and avatars.

shadow.note: One quiet elevation. Paper lies flat; nothing floats except menus.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The notebook sheet: the one lifted object on the home screen.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then 2px solid brand.
